root_cause.text: The cpuset code fails to handle the case where subpartitions_cpus becomes empty due to CPU hotplug, causing a spurious warning in remote_partition_disable() and leaving remote partitions invalid without proper invalidation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies two parts: (1) In `remote_partition_disable()`, the warning condition `WARN_ON_ONCE(!cpumask_subset(cs->effective_xcpus, subpartitions_cpus))` is changed to `WARN_ON_ONCE(!cpumask_subset(cs->effective_xcpus, subpartitions_cpus) && !cpumask_empty(subpartitions_cpus))` to avoid the false warning when subpartitions_cpus is empty. (2) In `cpuset_hotplug_update_tasks()`, the condition to invoke `remote_partition_disable()` is expanded to include `cpumask_empty(subpartitions_cpus)`, and the condition for invalidating local partitions is similarly extended, ensuring partitions are invalidated when subpartitions_cpus is empty.

(2) In `cpuset_hotplug_update_tasks()`, the condition to invoke `remote_partition_disable()` is expanded to include `cpumask_empty(subpartitions_cpus)`, and the condition for invalidating local partitions is similarly extended, ensuring partitions are invalidated when subpartitions_cpus is empty.

intent_record.intent_summary: Suppress spurious WARN_ON_ONCE for remote partition disable when subpartitions_cpus becomes empty due to CPU offlining.
intent_record.what: Modified the condition in WARN_ON_ONCE from a single check '!cpumask_subset(cs->effective_xcpus, subpartitions_cpus)' to a conjunction: '!cpumask_subset(...) && !cpumask_empty(subpartitions_cpus)'.
intent_record.how: The warning is now only triggered if effective_xcpus is not a subset of subpartitions_cpus AND subpartitions_cpus is non-empty. Previously, the warning would fire even when subpartitions_cpus was empty, which occurred during legitimate CPU offlining scenarios.

intent_record.intent_summary: Handle the case where subpartitions_cpus becomes empty during hotplug by disabling the remote partition.
intent_record.what: Added an OR condition to the if statement: now triggers if subpartitions_cpus is empty, in addition to the original condition (new_cpus empty and partition populated).
intent_record.how: When remote is true and subpartitions_cpus is empty, the code now sets partition error and disables the remote partition, potentially fixing a missing case where subpartition CPUs vanish due to hotplug.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing check for empty subpartitions_cpus to invalidate local partition during hotplug update.
intent_record.what: Added a third condition `cpumask_empty(subpartitions_cpus)` to the if statement that triggers partition invalidation for a local partition, alongside existing checks for invalid parent or tasks_nocpu_error. Also updated the comment to list this new condition.
intent_record.how: During cpuset hotplug update, a local partition will now be invalidated if its subpartitions_cpus mask is empty, in addition to the previous conditions. This prevents a partition from remaining valid when it has no CPUs assigned to its subpartitions.

grouping_result.intent: Add missing check for empty subpartitions_cpus to invalidate local partition during hotplug update.

consistency_review.core_intent: Add missing handling for empty subpartitions_cpus during hotplug to properly invalidate or disable local and remote partitions.

relevance_review.reason: Group 0 directly addresses the root cause by adding handling for empty subpartitions_cpus during hotplug, including suppressing spurious warnings, disabling remote partitions, and invalidating local partitions.

candidates.rationale: This WARN_ON_ONCE triggers spuriously when subpartitions_cpus becomes empty due to CPU hotplug, as cpumask_subset of any non-empty effective_xcpus into an empty set is false, causing a false positive warning and preventing proper partition invalidation.

This condition (start of if-block) fails to check for emptiness of subpartitions_cpus, so when subpartitions_cpus becomes empty but the new effective cpus (new_cpus) are not empty, the remote partition is not disabled, leaving it in an invalid state without proper invalidation.

This continuation of the condition also lacks a check for subpartitions_cpus emptiness, thus only triggering remote partition disable when the partition is populated, but not when subpartitions_cpus is empty, leading to missing invalidation.

This condition for invalidating a local partition does not consider the case where subpartitions_cpus becomes empty, so a local partition with an empty subpartitions_cpus may not be invalidated, leaving it in an inconsistent state.

This continuation of the local partition invalidation condition fails to check for empty subpartitions_cpus, so the partition may remain valid even though subpartitions_cpus is empty, causing the vulnerability.
